events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Ernie Clement’s two-run homer in the 10th inning lifted the Toronto Blue Jays to a 5-4 win over the Houston Astros Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ernie Clement’s 10th-inning, 2-run homer lifts the Blue Jays past the Astros

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Pete Crow-Armstrong homered twice and drove in four runs, and the Chicago Cubs swept Shohei Ohtani and the struggling Los Angeles Dodgers with a wild 7-6 victory on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crow-Armstrong goes deep twice as the Cubs sweep Ohtani and the Dodgers with a wild 7-6 win

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Texas starter Cody Bradford pitched 4 1/3 effective innings in his first appearance since September 2024, and Justin Foscue’s two-run triple highlighted a four-run third inning as the Rangers beat the San Francisco Giants 6-0 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cody Bradford pitches 4 1/3 effective innings in first outing since 2024 as Rangers blank Giants 6-0

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Junior Caminero homered for the third time in the series, Victor Mesa Jr. tripled twice and the AL-best Tampa Bay Rays beat the Colorado Rockies 4-0 on Wednesday for a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Junior Caminero homers and Victor Mesa Jr. triples twice as Rays beat Rockies 4-0 for 3-game sweep

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Tyler O’Neill and Coby Mayo hit successive homers in the fourth inning, Trevor Rogers took a two-hitter into the seventh and the Baltimore Orioles beat the Los Angeles Angels 5-2 Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: O'Neill and Mayo hit back-to-back HRs, Taveras also goes deep as Orioles beat Angels 5-2

events.name: New York Mets at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Bo Bichette singled off Matt Festa to score automatic runner Francisco Lindor in the 10th inning, helping the New York Mets to a wild 6-5 victory over the Cleveland Guardians on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bo Bichette drives in run in 10th inning in the Mets' 6-5 win over the Guardians

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — JJ Wetherholt hit a two-run double and scored on Iván Herrera's ground-rule double to help Andre Pallante and the St. Louis Cardinals beat the punchless New York Yankees 3-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wetherholt and Pallante lead Cardinals to 3-1 victory over punchless Yankees

headlines.description: — CJ Abrams hit a tiebreaking, two-run triple in Washington's six-run 11th inning, pitcher Miles Mikolas drove in a run in his first at-bat since 2021, and the Nationals snapped their seven-game skid with a 10-4 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies...
headlines.shortLinkText: Abrams hits tiebreaking triple in 11th and pitcher Mikolas drives in run as Nats beat Phils 10-4

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Wilyer Abreu homered for the fourth time in three games, Sonny Gray struck out eight in six innings for his 14th win, and the surging Boston Red Sox beat the Chicago White Sox 4-0 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Abreu homers again, Gray gets 14th victory as Red Sox beat White Sox 4-0 for 7th straight win

headlines.description: — Bryce Elder pitched one-hit ball over seven innings, Drake Baldwin drove in two runs and the Atlanta Braves won their season-high seventh in a row, beating the Miami Marlins 4-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Elder leads the 1st-place Braves to their 7th win in a row, 4-1 over the Marlins

headlines.description: — Kyle Harrison struck out the final eight batters he faced, William Contreras homered and the Milwaukee Brewers beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 4-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Harrison Ks the final 8 batters he faces, the Brewers beat the Pirates 4-2

events.name: Minnesota Twins at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Michael Massey led off the seventh inning with a go-ahead home run, Noah Cameron had nine strikeouts in eight innings of one-run ball and the Kansas City Royals beat the Minnesota Twins 2-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Massey leads off 7th with go-ahead HR, Cameron has 9 Ks as Royals beat Twins 2-1

headlines.description: — Julio Rodríguez and Colt Emerson hit home runs, Bryan Woo pitched seven scoreless innings and the Seattle Mariners beat the Detroit Tigers 4-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodríguez and Emerson hit HRs, Woo pitches 7 scoreless innings as Mariners beat Tigers 4-2

events.name: San Diego Padres at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Mitch Bratt struck out nine and allowed one hit in seven innings for his first career victory, Ildemaro Vargas drove in four runs and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the San Diego Padres 10-4 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bratt Ks 9 in 7 1-hit innings for 1st win in majors, helping Diamondbacks rout Padres 10-4
